task_description: Given a list of extracted entities from ExtractorJSON, map every endpoint that contains an object reference (numeric ID, UUID, or sequential parameter). Do not evaluate whether any endpoint is vulnerable.
notes: Synthetic controlled-lab case for the endpoint_mapper worker role (docs/04_WORKER_SKILL_CONTRACTS.md, workers/endpoint_mapper). A deterministic transformation task with a known-correct result, per Context-4 task brief §6's 'known correct transformation/result' example.
